quirks.shell_open_ignored: When LTspice is already running, os.startfile does not load documents into the active instance. Use Ctrl+O dialog recipe.
quirks.batch_cli_unreliable: Avoid running LTspice.exe in batch mode (-b) without active graphical context as it may block indefinitely.

empty_workspace.name: Empty Workspace
empty_workspace.description: LTspice is open with no schematic or waveform active.

schematic_open.name: Schematic Active
schematic_open.description: An .asc schematic file is loaded in the workspace ready for editing or simulation.

waveform_active.name: Waveform Viewer Active
waveform_active.description: Simulation has executed and the .raw waveform viewer pane is open.

trace_picker_dialog.name: Select Visible Waveforms Dialog
trace_picker_dialog.description: Modal dialog displaying list of available net voltages and currents to plot.

open_schematic.name: Open Schematic
open_schematic.description: Reliably opens a schematic file using in-app hotkey Ctrl+O, typing the path, and pressing Enter.

run_simulation.name: Run Simulation
run_simulation.description: Triggers simulation of the active schematic via the Run toolbar button.

open_trace_picker.name: Open Trace Picker
open_trace_picker.description: Opens the 'Select Visible Waveforms' modal dialog from the waveform viewer.
